I replied to Ilse in a thread on her #north-team message. I couldn't confirm the tip. I'm treating it as unverified and won't record Oriel Brevik as the Linden contact anywhere.

- **What I checked:** a search of the shared knowledge base for "Oriel Brevik" and "Linden" found nothing beyond her own message, which the workspace saves automatically.
- **Who can confirm:** Marrow Fieldworks looks like a Central team account; a note says it changed hands on 5 Jan 2026. So in my reply I pointed her to the Central team to confirm who the contact is.

I didn't need any approvals and didn't send any mail.
